verdict.label: HOLD — H2 Opens With 9th Gate Failure; 10Y at 4.46% Is New Headwind; Fear & Greed 27 (Fear) Prevents Escalation
verdict.rationale_short: H2 2026 opens with nine consecutive failures to clear both regime gates (SPX below 7,460; VIX above 17). The 10Y yield rose to 4.46% overnight (+9 bps from June 30's 4.37% close), a new hawkish headwind compressing Nasdaq's ~28x P/E multiple, with the 30Y approaching the 5.00% trigger. BTC fell to $58,644 (Crypto.com live, 11:06 UTC July 1) — Day 11 of the exit gate — with Bitcoin spot ETFs recording $4.5B in June outflows, their worst month since launch. Q2 window-dressing support has expired as of the June 30 close, removing the primary mechanical tailwind that sustained SPX through Q2's final weeks. Two catalysts arrive today: ADP Employment at 8:15am ET (May 122K private jobs) and ISM Manufacturing at 10am ET (May 54%; prediction markets see June at 52-53%). The more decisive binary is NFP July 2 at 8:30am ET, unhedgeable through a 3-day July 4 holiday gap. HOLD is maintained — not escalated to STEP ASIDE — because the Fear & Greed Index hit 27 (Fear) as of June 30, a contrarian signal that meaningful pessimism has been priced in. BUY upgrade requires SPX closing above 7,460 AND VIX closing below 17 simultaneously, confirmed by Goldilocks NFP (130-170K, wages +0.2-0.3%) on July 2.

bear_case: Counter-argument: the 10Y yield rising to 4.46% (+9 bps) on H2's opening day is the session's most important overnight development, and the one most likely to be underweighted by the bulls. At Nasdaq P/E ~28x, every 10 basis points of yield expansion erodes the fair-value floor by 3-4%. The 30Y is tracking toward 4.90-4.95%, within 5-10 bps of the 5.00% trigger that would add a third concurrent regime breach. Nine consecutive gate failures now extend into Q3 without the mechanical window-dressing support that anchored Q2's final sessions. BTC at $58,644 on Day 11 — with Bitcoin spot ETFs recording their worst monthly performance since launch — signals that speculative capital is systematically reducing risk alongside equity headline strength. The US is investigating 60 countries for forced-labor tariff violations, a new 10-12.5% tariff overhang whose full market impact has not been priced. A strong NFP tomorrow (>200K) arrives through a 3-day unhedgeable July 4 gap, locking in BofA's three-hike path with no exit available. Invalidation: SPX closes above 7,460 AND VIX closes below 17 simultaneously today, followed by Goldilocks NFP (130-170K, wages +0.2%) on July 2 — BUY upgrade validated with multi-week conviction into Q3 earnings.
